verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is a local web app, so asking whether its UI functions are also exposed through an API is a fair question. The evidence never mentions a documented API. The main workflow (submitting a reference, approving the plan, chat revisions, video comments) is described only through the UI. The two CLI scripts (`npm run post-video` for publishing and `npm run doctor` for setup checks) are adjacent tools, not API parity with the UI.
